summary: B1 implementation is ready for fixed acceptance after focused authority, source and integration checks. The exact catalog separates identity, edition intervals, source bytes and provision selection; it retains unresolved temporal/context evidence and feeds selected context into both inventories before marking acquisition resolved.
findings: Wrong edition, ambiguous authority/version, unknown dates, forged spans, changed bytes, missing files and path escape have explicit refusal tests. Source anchors support catalog assertions but do not prove legal applicability.

Actual official navigation yielded four retained documents: codes index, current and September 2023 Code PDFs, and the 30 September 2010 FAQ page. The FAQ page expressly mentions 2024 answer updates; its historical version remains UNKNOWN_VERSION. This is an actual source limitation, not a fabricated effective interval.

Paragraph 3.11 includes its fee/charge exception. Context selection includes interpretation/definition pages; SFO/Banking Ordinance references remain unresolved. Complete PDF bytes survive. Bounded selection is visibly distinct from complete authority coverage.

Review found that resolving a locator before a second context pass could remove a dependency even when no context reached the readers. Corrected that path; one-pass and two-pass integration tests establish the difference.

A PDF resource inspection bug on indirect annotation arrays was found on the actual Code and repaired. Nested forms are inspected for image/paint operations; plain text forms alone do not trigger image findings. Mixed-text/scanned content remains flagged even when extractors agree. No OCR or visual completeness certification is claimed.
Selected ranges must equal the union of their anchored regions; changing only a range mask cannot drop a qualification. Excess context bytes return no truncated document.
One source-preparation metadata serialization failure was retained and repaired without replacing source bytes. The accepted B0 evidence and global live-call allowance remain protected.

Method/default audit: exact matching and conservative uncertainty handling are engineering choices; catalog effective intervals use retained publisher edition dates, not assumed universal legal effect. No superiority, legal accuracy or savings claim follows from these deterministic cases.

Acceptance runs all assurance regressions and the retained-source authority scenario. Ordinary failures trigger repair; unavailable historical FAQ evidence blocks temporal resolution only, not independent subsequent engineering. No new model calls are dispatched.
remaining_limits: Historical FAQ applicability, statutory definitions and proposed context selections remain unresolved.
No completeness guarantee for visual PDF content or all applicable law.
B2 through B5 remain pending and will proceed after acceptance.
